doesNotKnow: Compute rectangle-union area by sweeping event x-coordinates and maintaining covered y-length.

misconception: Adding rectangle areas then subtracting only pair overlaps always handles many overlaps.
objective: Compute rectangle-union area by sweeping event x-coordinates and maintaining covered y-length.

claims.text: Each x slab contributes its width times the merged covered y-length. Merging active intervals before multiplication prevents overlapping rectangles from charging the same area more than once.
